snp1.1:1.1: A monk who removes anger when it appears,
snp1.1:1.2: as one removes a serpent’s venom using medicines,
snp1.1:1.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:1.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:2.1: A monk who completely cuts off passion,
snp1.1:2.2: like a lotus plant dropping its flowers,
snp1.1:2.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:2.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:3.1: A monk who has completely severed craving,
snp1.1:3.2: who has dried up the swiftly flowing river,
snp1.1:3.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:3.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:4.1: A monk who completely destroys conceit,
snp1.1:4.2: like a flood destroys a fragile bamboo bridge,
snp1.1:4.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:4.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:5.1: A monk who sees no value in states of being,
snp1.1:5.2: as one does not find flowers on fig trees,
snp1.1:5.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:5.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:6.1: A monk in whom there is no anger,
snp1.1:6.2: who has completely gone beyond both being and non-being,
snp1.1:6.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:6.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:7.1: A monk who has completely blown away their thoughts,
snp1.1:7.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:7.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:8.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:8.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:8.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:9.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:9.2: who knows that the world is completely false,
snp1.1:9.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:9.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:10.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:10.2: who is free of greed, knowing it to be completely false,
snp1.1:10.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:10.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:11.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:11.2: who is free of passion, knowing it to be completely false,
snp1.1:11.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:11.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:12.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:12.2: who is free of hatred, knowing it to be completely false,
snp1.1:12.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:12.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:13.1: A monk who neither goes too far nor goes back,
snp1.1:13.2: who is free of delusion, knowing it to be completely false,
snp1.1:13.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:13.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:14.1: A monk who has no subconscious tendencies,
snp1.1:14.2: who has eliminated the unwholesome roots,
snp1.1:14.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:14.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:15.1: A monk who has no anxiety whatsoever
snp1.1:15.2: about this life or the next,
snp1.1:15.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:15.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:16.1: A monk who has no desire whatsoever
snp1.1:16.2: based on which one might be bound to existence,
snp1.1:16.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:16.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:17.1: A monk who has discarded the five hindrances,
snp1.1:17.2: who is untroubled, free of doubt, unafflicted,
snp1.1:17.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:17.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
